defective_pattern: Executing an unconditional, non-branching mechanical check for '3-table regression structure' on an SEM manuscript.
why_defective: Fails to distinguish between regression and SEM deliverables, incorrectly marking SEM manuscripts as failing due to missing regression tables.
observed_symptoms: Validation failure for SEM manuscript due to missing 3-table regression structure.
corrective_remedy: Implement conditional branching in validation-agent/thesis-integrity-auditor to apply the 3-table regression invariant only to regression manuscripts, bypassing it for SEM manuscripts.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Deterministic regex pattern matching unconditional 3-table check on SEM
